$s.Rate = 0
$path = Join-Path $PWD "announcement.wav"
$s.SetOutputToWaveFile($path)
$s.Speak("Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors.")
$s.Dispose()
Write-Output "done: $path"
